# Audit 227

## Overview

This skill wraps a script in `~/AppData/Local/hermes/scripts/` for Audit task 227 for monitoring and auditing.

## Script Purpose

The script Audit task 227 for monitoring and auditing within the Hermes ecosystem.

## Usage

```bash
# For Python scripts
python $LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/scripts/audit_227.py [options]

# For Node.js/CJS scripts  
node $LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/scripts/audit_227.cjs [options]

# For PowerShell scripts
pwsh -File $LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/scripts/audit_227.ps1 [options]

# For Bash scripts
bash $LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/scripts/audit_227.sh [options]
```

## Typical Output

The script produces reports, audit findings, or transformation results that can be reviewed for quality assurance.
